name: s81-quality-gate-broken-python3-skips-py
setup_commands: chmod +x minbin/python3 && mkdir -p minbin && for t in bash sh git dirname basename tr date mkdir tail head sed grep cat env rm mv cp perl sleep cksum; do p=$(command -v "$t") && ln -sf "$p" "minbin/$t"; done; true
notes: python3 is the macOS stub that only prints an xcode-select note and exits 1, and ruff isn't installed. The gate picked py_compile by `command -v python3`, so every valid .py edit was recorded as failed and stop blocked with no way out. With no working python3 and no ruff the edit is skipped (tool-unavailable): NOT verified, never failed.
